endpoint_token: absolute index len(prompt_ids)+end_token_index; the token itself, not its predecessor or next-token vector
direct_generation_hidden: LLM.generate has no hidden return. Public LLM.apply_model eager hooks actually captured all 32 mapped endpoint vectors with token/position checks; REJECTED_NUMERICAL_EQUIVALENCE at the predeclared elementwise tolerance. No engine source changed.

sampling.presence_penalty: Subtract 1.5 ONCE for each seen generated suffix ID; prompt excluded; repetition_penalty=1 is inactive
sampling.ordering: repetition/frequency/presence; temperature; min_p (inactive); top_k then top_p
sampling.rng: Native vLLM uses exponential sampling with per-request torch.Generator; original torch.multinomial is in a different Torch/kernel runtime. Do not infer bitwise equality: actual fixed 512-token comparison diverges at zero-based token index 313. Same-engine repeat is exact.
sampling.output: detokenize=False; raw output.token_ids decoded with original tokenizer skip_special_tokens=False; explicit EOS assertion; no reasoning parser

stage3.prefix_cache: disabled; never claimed full KV/GDN/RNG snapshot
stage3.HF_restore: Original full tensor deepcopy including attention KV, conv_states, recurrent_states and flags; clone preserves RNG; FAIL deliberately retains current RNG and cumulative counters per original plan
stage3.reference_replay: cross-engine sampled prefix cannot be assumed; Stage3 rejects vLLM source manifests
stage3.timing: Any future engine wake/sleep, fresh prefill, snapshot/restore, feedback forward and verifier time must be included in synchronized T_request
